description:
[measured] One rule tested on up to 100 coins in a single call: on which coins it was true in
    our hourly archive, what price did over the next 24 h and 72 h per coin (share up, median,
    worst, best) next to each coin's base rate, the POOLED outcome across coins with the number
    of distinct days behind it (coins move together, so days, not episodes, are the sample), and
    `true_now`: the coins the rule is true on right now. Use it to find where a setup has
    occurred and where it is live, instead of calling test_rule per coin. Frequencies from our
    archive, NOT a forecast; the note explains why the best of many scans is not an edge.
    Priced: $1.00 per call (x402, USDC on Base or Arbitrum), 200 prepaid credits (one $1 pack),
    or a Pro/Bot key. Takes 10-40 s on a cold cache.
